instruction: Open the provided init.ifc model in Bonsai and use init_plan.png as the plan reference. Modify the existing single-floor apartment so the former bedroom is split into two bedrooms, then save the completed IFC4 model as result.ifc and export a space schedule as result.csv with a Bonsai or IfcCSV-style workflow. The completed model should keep one project, one site, one building, and one building storey. It should contain exactly five spaces named Living, Kitchen, Bed 1, Bed 2, and Bath, using real IfcSpace objects. Include at least eight walls, at least one door, at least one void relationship, and at least one fill relationship. Do not use building element proxies or furniture as substitutes. The CSV schedule should have headers SpaceName, Level, and NetFloorArea, and it should contain exactly one row for each of Living, Kitchen, Bed 1, Bed 2, and Bath. Each row should list Level as Ground Floor and provide a positive numeric NetFloorArea. Other details may vary.
